description: Click-to-Call: returns the Teams deep link that starts a call to a lead or contact in the USER'S OWN Teams client. Opening that link is what places the call — this tool does not dial and deliberately does NOT write a call into the history, because a link that nobody clicked is not a conversation. The history entry comes afterwards from the Teams call record. Needs no Graph permission and no admin consent; the calling licence belongs to the user, not to CallPilotAI. A national number is completed with the tenant's default_calling_code when one is set, and otherwise REFUSED rather than guessed: from a cloud phone system that dials nothing at best and someone in another country at worst, and a call cannot be taken back.

default_country.description: Country code without '+' (e.g. '49', '41') used for national numbers. Without it a national number is refused.

number.description: Dial this instead of looking one up.

with_video.description: Start the Teams call with video

name: start_teams_call
